essays.text: 英譯中：（15 分）The world is currently going through significant changes as trade warsevolve into technology and capital wars, possibly leading to a new form ofeconomic cold war. The lack of global coordination is causing more divisions,putting the world order at risk. We need to move beyond individualrelationships and create global solutions for global challenges. What willhappen if there is another global financial crisis? What if there is anotherworldwide contagion? What will we do when we face global challenges likedroughts, floods, and fires? We must redesign the global architecture tostrengthen the international liberal order and address the current geopoliticalchallenges.

中譯英：（15 分）貧窮是我們這個時代的一個迫切問題，須要立即關注。COVID-19 大流行導致極端貧困人數激增，這是這一世代人從來沒見過的情況。諸如兒童疫苗接種和國與國之間收入平等的關鍵進展並不如預期，這在過去三十年中是很少見的。貧窮不僅僅是缺乏可持續生計的收入和資源。它也表現為飢餓、營養不良、獲得教育和其他基本服務的機會有限、社會歧視和排斥、以及缺乏對決策的參與。如果目前的趨勢持續下去，到 2030 年，仍有高達 5.75 億人生活在極端貧困中，其中 8,400 萬兒童將無法上學。

英文寫作：（45 分）總字數限制：350 字以內。Write an essay of no more than 350 words to comment on the topic below.Discuss possible positive and negative views and give your own opinion.Support your position and discourse with reasoning and/or examples fromreadings, studies, experience, or observations.Keeping up with the current geopolitical policy issues is crucial in today’sforeign affairs. What impact do you think the development of AI technologycan have on geopolitical policies?

What does it mean when the speaker mentioned“achieving a new mindset”in the first paragraph?
opts: To conceive new plans for life.
To offer new perspectives to life.
To learn from people around him.
To pay more attention to details.
mcq.passage: The process of achieving a new mindset of learning from those around me came through the cultivation of relationships. I became fascinated by the new perspectives each person in my life could offer if I really took the time to connect. Not only did I improve my listening skills, but I began to consider the big-picture consequences my engagements could have. People interpret situations differently due to their own cultural contexts, so I had to learn to pay more attention to details to understand every point of view. I took on the state of what I like to call collaborative independence, and to my delight, I was elected to Student Government after my third year of trying. Not long ago, I would have fallen apart at the presence of any uncertainty. As I further accept and advance new life skills, the more I realize how much remains uncertain in the world. After all, it is quite possible my future job doesn’t exist yet, and that’s okay. I can’t conceivably plan out my entire life at the age of 17, but what I can do is prepare myself to take on the unknown, doing my best to accompany others. Hopefully, my wings continue enabling me to fly, but it is going to take more than just me and my wings; I have to continue putting my faith in the air around me.
